policies.name: Growth
policies.mandate: Find durable revenue expansion. Prefer positive operating income. Do not mistake one quarter for a durable trend.

policies.name: Quality
policies.mandate: Prefer positive operating income, resilient margins and consistent earnings. Penalize deterioration. Cash is valid.

policies.name: Turnaround
policies.mandate: Look for improving operating results after weakness. Require observable recovery; cheap valuation cannot be inferred from filings alone.
